game.name: PocketPlex
game.desc: A lightweight, text-first Plex client for retro handhelds. Links your account with a PIN, browses your Plex Media Server over Wi-Fi, and plays video/music via server-side transcode.
Browses Movies, TV and Music libraries.
Plays 640x480 H.264/AAC via PMS HLS transcode (subtitles burned in).
